data.description: Fold the signed sidebar-reorg prototype (v1.15, Atin love pass 2026-08-14) into the build. Full scope, acceptance sketches, and dependencies: sequence/sidebar-fold-tickets.md §T1. Summary: route-table.ts regroups to Organization (Home · People CRM · Outreach · Settings) / conference core (Program pipeline · Program board · Abstracts & sessions · Agenda · Speakers) / Speaker ops / Call for proposals / Public links / Settings + footer; the seven-row Pipeline ladder is removed; renames (Program pipeline, People CRM — rewrite the route-table comment arguing against CRM; Outreach); icon curation (leading external arrows, reserved 16px column); Conference group label over the picker, eyebrow removed, 6px gap; + affordance on the Abstracts & sessions row; register.ts navLabels rework and zeroPadNavIcons retirement/repoint; NEW stage-flyout component on the Program pipeline row (Overview row first, stages 1-7 with live counts from the dashboard snapshot, 150/220ms hover intent, focus-opens, retires under 1000px); /lists becomes a tab inside People CRM with the People row active (builds on PR #224); one centered content column shared by every admin page (max-width ~1500px, margin auto — the prototype found crm pages pinned left while pipeline pages centered). Design contract: prototypes/pipeline-v1.1 + prototypes/crm + prototypes/sidebar-reorg (R1-R5); rulings in sequence/run-state.md 2026-08-14.
data.title: Sidebar reorg fold: nav structure, stage flyout, Lists into People, centered page column

data.body: PR #258 open: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/258 — branch mrq-203-sidebar-fold on cdcc4883. Route table regrouped (organization/conference/speaker-ops/cfp/public-links/settings), 7 pipeline rows keep paths and lose rows, stage flyout on the Program pipeline row reading a publish/subscribe dashboard snapshot (zero fetch on hover), /lists as the People screen's second tab, chrome per v1.15. Org Home + org Settings rows deliberately left to MRQ-207 (no org routes exist yet; a row to a missing route is a dead end) — assigned to 207 by the captain. Verified in headless Chromium against a seeded local Worker: groups as ruled, flyout counts == dashboard strip counts, 6px picker gap, all labels at one x, 1920px column 1500/98/98 on all ten admin pages including People CRM, flyout absent at 900px, all five registers 19 rows 0 empty.
CI fast-gate: pass (6m57s, run 31841466582) — covers the full npm test and trace:ac --scope=merged that were not run locally under the load-event suspension. PR #258 awaiting merge-captain review.

MERGED by Merge Captain: PR #258 squashed to de2d707a at 2026-08-14 17:21 ET. CI fast-gate pass (6m57s, real pass not timeout); MERGEABLE/CLEAN. Reviewed by Merge Captain (not the author) before merge, verified independently rather than from the PR body: (1) reachability — tests/unit/route-table.test.ts:47 lists ~42 pre-existing paths LITERALLY from cdcc4883, not derived from the table under test, and includes hidden aliases /crm /directory /contacts plus all seven /submissions?status= stage paths, which kept their paths under group 'utility'; (2) the four tests/node contract tests broken by the reorg were updated with rationale, not weakened — two gained assertions; (3) people.MRQ-131 rewritten not deleted, one assertion tightened; (4) zero src/ changes since the sha its full local suite ran on; (5) flyout contract HOVER_OPEN_MS=150 / HOVER_CLOSE_MS=220, FLYOUT_MIN_WIDTH=1000 with matchMedia, and no fetch in StageFlyout (R7 zero-fetch-on-hover); (6) .page centering evidenced by measurement at 1920 (width 1500, left 98, right 98 across 10 admin routes). Route ids stayed stable (people, sourcing) so MRQ-205 builds on the label rename as promised. Organization group ships as People CRM · Outreach · Settings; org Home row+route belong to MRQ-209 per earlier ruling. Rebase ordered to MRQ-204/205/206/207.

REVIEW — APPROVE (Merge Captain, surface:302; not the author). Head fbeafe26, merged as de2d707a. CI fast-gate pass 6m57s (genuine pass, not a timeout); MERGEABLE/CLEAN. I read the diff and verified the load-bearing claims independently rather than from the PR body.

VERIFIED: (1) Reachability — route-table.test.ts:47 asserts ~42 pre-existing paths listed LITERALLY from cdcc4883, not derived from the table under test, so it cannot rot into a tautology; hidden aliases /crm /directory /contacts and all seven /submissions?status= stage paths are in it, and those seven kept their paths under group 'utility' so no bookmarked URL 404s. (2) The four tests/node contract tests the reorg broke were updated WITH RATIONALE, not weakened — two gained assertions; the 6px picker gap and Tasks moving to speaker-ops are ruled design changes. (3) people.MRQ-131 rewritten not deleted, one assertion tightened (fetchLists/setListState proximity, with a stated reason about index caps). (4) Zero src/ changes since 5bea5182, the sha its full local suite ran on, so that evidence still held at the merged head. (5) Flyout: HOVER_OPEN_MS=150, HOVER_CLOSE_MS=220, FLYOUT_MIN_WIDTH=1000 via matchMedia, and NO fetch in StageFlyout.tsx — R7 zero-fetch-on-hover satisfied by the snapshot store. (6) .page centering evidenced by measurement at 1920 (width 1500, left 98, right 98 across ten admin routes), after I rejected 'already centers' as mechanism rather than evidence. (7) Route ids stable (people, sourcing) with labels only moving to People CRM / Outreach — the contract MRQ-205 was told to build on.

NON-BLOCKING: none material.

SCOPE RULING CARRIED: Organization group ships as People CRM · Outreach · Settings. MRQ-203 correctly declined to mint org Home/Settings rows pointing at routes that do not exist (dead-end rule); MRQ-207 owns the Settings row+route, MRQ-209 owns the Home row+route together with its page.

Merged as de2d707a (PR #258 squashed, 17:21 ET). Worktree ../Marquee-worktrees/mrq-203-sidebar-fold removed cleanly — nothing uncommitted in it. Noted for the follow-ups: Organization ships as People CRM · Outreach · Settings, with MRQ-207 owning the Settings row + /org route and MRQ-209 owning the Home row together with its route (captain's ruling, recorded on MRQ-209). My Sidebar.tsx needs no change for either — both are group: "organization" entries in route-table.ts.
